# Stocks Drop, Bonds Gain as Tech Results Underwhelm: Markets Wrap

[Video 2](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-29/stock-market-today-dow-s-p-live-updates)

White House National Economic Council Director Kevin Hassett expects the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates if inflation figures for this month are elevated. Speaking on “Bloomberg The Open” shortly after the latest PCE inflation report, Hassett says the Fed will “probably appropriately act” if inflation data come out high.Source: Bloomberg

October 29, 2026 at 10:07 PM UTC

Updated on 

October 30, 2026 at 4:16 AM UTC

Save

Technology shares led a global stock selloff as another round of disappointing earnings accelerated a rotation out of the artificial intelligence trade and drove investors toward haven assets such as Treasuries. Crude oil gained.

Futures for the Nasdaq 100 Index slid 2.2% after earnings from [Amazon.com](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-29/amazon-spending-soars-on-effort-to-meet-demand-for-ai-services) Inc. and Intel Corp. raised fresh concerns about capital expenditure. Amazon slumped 7.3% in extended trading, while Intel [plunged](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-29/intel-outlook-hurt-by-weak-market-for-personal-computer-chips) 23%. Bitcoin fell 1.2% to below $78,000 after Binance, the world’s largest crypto exchange, suspended all deposits and withdrawals as it investigated a [suspected hack](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-29/binance-founder-says-possible-hack-of-exchange-bitcoin-falls).
